name: Works Of The Flesh
overview: The Scriptures reveal that the works of the flesh originate from the sinful desires within the human heart, producing actions such as adultery, fornication, theft, covetousness, and other immoral behaviors (Mark 7:21-22; Galatians 5:19). Believers are called to resist these fleshly lusts by walking in the Spirit, which empowers them not to fulfill the desires of the flesh (Galatians 5:16). Rather than using Christian liberty as an opportunity for fleshly indulgence, the believer is to serve others in love, reflecting a life transformed by grace (Galatians 5:13). The consequence of giving in to these lusts is spiritual uncleanness and dishonor, as God allows those who reject Him to follow the desires of their own hearts (Romans 1:24).
